spin test = rotated electrode geometry (preserves spatial autocorrelation, conservative). The 1000-value distribution is DRAWN as a 10th-90th box-whisker per item (Q1-Q3 box + median, whiskers to p10/p90, no fliers), with the 95th pct as a dashed critical line on top. All 1000 values remain in fig6_rsa_quantification_forest_spin_nulls.csv; the drawn summary is in fig6_rsa_quantification_forest_null_box_stats.csv. Shuffle p is kept in the Source Data for completeness but is anti-conservative for spatial maps and is not drawn.

resting control (patient IW vs healthy yoked-REST): only its OWN spin-null box-whisker is drawn, offset +0.30 x-units (0.7x width, white fill, lighter line work) - deliberately subordinate to the main box. The resting-control rho itself is not drawn (it is in the Source Data). NO p95 dash is drawn on it: the control carries no significance claim.
